scope: Static inert partition analysis of two previously resource-limited sources, ten selected dependencies and seven native integrity discrepancies. No application-wide or runtime completeness claim.
source_code_policy: No vendor source bodies or resources are included. External evidence under /private/tmp is local and temporary; identifiers, hashes, ranges, observations and aggregate counts below are metadata.

lexical_index.basis: static lexical binding index of original full AST; dynamic properties, runtime reassignment and eval not resolved

findings.statement: La petición de permiso de anotación comparte la promesa pendiente, genera un identificador y solo acepta la respuesta con el identificador vigente; el fallo IPC resuelve denegación.
findings.unresolved: El receptor del proceso principal y la decisión real del usuario requieren evidencia adicional.

findings.statement: El montaje diferido comprueba si la página ya se destruyó. El controlador de solicitudes comprueba identidad de petición, pausa y destrucción después de esperar el permiso.
findings.unresolved: No se ejecutaron carreras de navegación ni restauración desde la caché de páginas.

findings.statement: La inicialización de la API de anotación se restringe a contexto seguro y marco superior; los disparadores comprueban activación de usuario y estado de control por el agente.
findings.unresolved: Son condiciones de este módulo; no una prueba de política completa de la aplicación.

findings.statement: Los localizadores recorren la ruta de marcos y abandonan si un marco o su documento no es accesible. Los elementos retenidos se contrastan con ownerDocument y la ruta, y el documento de anotación tiene limpieza condicionada a conservar su identidad.
findings.unresolved: No se ha demostrado identidad estable a través de todas las navegaciones ni marcos remotos.

findings.statement: La salida definitiva de la página resuelve permisos pendientes y libera escuchas, previsualizaciones y la raíz UI; existen cierres explícitos para observadores y requestAnimationFrame.
findings.unresolved: Las rutas se observaron estáticamente, sin medición de fugas en ejecución.

limitations: Chunks are analysis inputs only and are never executed.
Copied source ranges are exact. Synthetic wrappers and a body-elided skeleton are explicitly mapped.
Chunk semantic relationships do not preserve original inter-chunk lexical scope; supplemental name references are candidates, not proof of runtime reachability.
Source map reference retained as provenance only; referenced map was not analyzed.
13 original delimiter bytes are represented by synthetic partition scaffolding, not copied byte-for-byte.
Static lexical index does not resolve dynamic property dispatch, runtime values or implicit arguments binding.
REA semantic coverage remains partial/unknown even when every partition parses successfully.
No vendor code was executed and no behavior of remote services was observed.

tools.analysis_execution: local CLI; inert source, never executed target
tools.note: Early untruncated single-part records used 20000 nodes / 5000 unknowns; see each complete Evidence.parameters. Old-space is not a total RSS limit.

limitations: Every effective input parsed and retained its observations without resource omissions, but original whole-application semantics remain unknown/partial.

24 derived fragments of original part19 have synthetic function wrappers or a body-elided skeleton. Their lexical context/control-flow/runtime semantics are not equivalent to the original. Twelve original delimiter/space bytes are rewritten, all functional bodies mapped.

Full-original-AST lexical relationships separately connect exact declarations and references. They are candidates, not runtime reachability, dynamic dispatch, property aliasing, mutation or policy enforcement.
The 50 exact joins plus 61 exact standalone parts and 24 derived inputs do not review all other Codex modules or remote services.
Counts of retained unknown records aggregate per-input occurrences and must not be presented as distinct defects or security findings.

validation.method: gzip CRC and streamed SHA-256/byte length match each retained complete JSON; manifest/hash/range validation separately supplied by integrity reviewer

findings.observation: La selección de permisos cruza las restricciones de sandbox, política de aprobación y revisor permitidos; la lista disponible contempla perfiles admitidos y una salida de configuración del servidor.
findings.jarvis_followup: Contrastar las capacidades y opciones de aprobación de Jarvis en UI/daemon; el texto no prueba aplicación efectiva en servidor.

findings.observation: El ciclo de arranque mantiene fases ordenadas, rechaza esperas abortadas y retira escuchas al completar o cancelar; dispose aborta esperas y limpia suscriptores.
findings.jarvis_followup: Aplicable a arranque y reconexión de Jarvis para impedir esperas huérfanas y actualizaciones después del cierre.

findings.observation: El transporte HTTP relaciona petición/cancelación con un identificador; la apertura de SSE distingue tiempo inicial y de inactividad y deja de ofrecer reintento cuando ya aceptó el stream. Se liberan recursos y listeners en salidas.
findings.jarvis_followup: Contrastar reintentos de NVIDIA y cancelación de sesiones; no atribuir exactamente-una-vez ni garantías remotas a este texto.

findings.observation: El cambio optimista de preferencias conserva el valor previo, revierte ante error e invalida el estado después. Las suscripciones tardías se descartan cuando su consumidor se cerró.
findings.jarvis_followup: Criterio para preferencias de Jarvis: estado confirmado, rollback y reconciliación de fallos inciertos.

findings.observation: Las definiciones de preferencias del navegador distinguen campos ocultos para el agente de campos editables; los controles de permisos y descargas tienen clasificación explícita.
findings.jarvis_followup: La política visible no acredita enforcement. Criterio para mantener decisiones del dueño separadas de opciones operativas.

findings.observation: La enumeración paginada de dueños de worktrees conserva un conjunto de cursores y lanza error cuando el servidor repite uno, además de validar tipos y filtrar archivados.
findings.jarvis_followup: Prueba útil para cualquier paginación Jarvis: cursor repetido debe terminar con error controlado y conservar el estado anterior.

findings.observation: La reordenación exige que la lista nueva conserve exactamente los elementos visibles y no contenga duplicados.
findings.jarvis_followup: Criterio para no perder conversaciones o proyectos al ordenar listas parciales.

findings.observation: Las formas de programación son una unión discriminada de hora/día/semana; validan hora, intervalo positivo, días no repetidos y objetos estrictos.
findings.jarvis_followup: Comparar validación UI/daemon de Jarvis; no se ha verificado ejecución del planificador remoto.

integrity.conclusion: ASAR metadata and signed installed resource bytes disagree. All seven native signatures and the enclosing application verify outside sandbox; every current native hash matches the signed CodeResources manifest. This establishes internally inconsistent ASAR metadata, not malicious alteration or a Jarvis defect. Post-ASAR signing is a plausible but unproven build-order explanation.
limitations: No pre-sign originals or publisher build logs; exact cause unknown.
Sandbox codesign exits were misleading and superseded by successful verification outside sandbox.
This is static local integrity evidence, not runtime policy or notarization service validation.
REA inventory pass deliberately selected package.json only and cannot support application semantic coverage.

independent_partition_verification.method: Independent checks of all saved partitions against exact original source bytes and Babel AST; no vendor code executed; no modifications to either agent directory.

claims: All exact original bytes appear once, in source order, across contiguous complete top-level statement parts.
Every recorded UTF-16 range maps exactly to its recorded UTF-8 byte range.
Partition identity is independent of REA completion.
limits: Isolated chunks lose binding context across chunks.
A full-source dependency index is static lexical evidence, not execution or whole-program semantic equivalence.
Standalone export parse failures can occur because bindings are declared in other chunks; separate from source corruption.

unions.interpretation: Exact unions of contiguous original fragments. Source binding context inside each union is larger, but inter-union relations remain unproven.

refined19.interpretation: Mapped snippets/skeleton ranges are exact; wrappers and an elided body change scope and execution semantics. Base file full-byte coverage does not mean these derived analyses preserve full semantics.

claims: Each mapped source range and its hashes exactly match the original, with correctly converted UTF-16/UTF-8 offsets.
Every emitted analysis input matches declared wrappers and skeleton body omission exactly.
limits: Rewriting variable declarations and adding one function wrapper per body statement changes lexical scope and evaluation semantics.
An empty-body skeleton proves the original header/call syntax only; it must not be interpreted as an empty function in the shipped app.
Original gaps must be classified explicitly before claiming all syntax or byte coverage.
The parts are never executable substitutes for the original source.
Four case fragments preserve exact case labels and bodies but replace the discriminant and function scope with explicitly declared synthetic scaffolding.
Case grouping does not preserve fallthrough across fragments, original function parameters, captured binding values, or whole-function control flow.
The case-elided skeleton preserves original function/discriminant/header syntax with no cases; its empty switch is not the shipped behavior.
Remaining source statements are regrouped under three artificial functions and their scope is not equivalent to the original function.
55 successful analyses refer to derived inputs; the earlier memory-limited part remains historical evidence and must not be counted as a successful or additional unique part.

jarvis_changes: Discard stale page text and errors after conversation/document changes; reserve request identity synchronously; cancel without blocking newer captures.
Reject project pagination cursor cycles within the accepted request generation before mutating visible rows.

verification.full_qualification: Commit and push hooks run after this snapshot; final delivery reports their results.

limitations: All final 190 partition inputs parsed without resource omissions; this is not a proof of complete application semantics or behavioral equivalence.
Synthetic wrappers change lexical/control-flow context; supplemental original-AST relationships identify names, not runtime dispatch or policy enforcement.
Unknown records and semantic counts aggregate derived-input occurrences, not unique bugs.
Additional-dependency analysis retains capped unknowns and excludes nonselected sources.
Other modules, dynamic execution and remote services remain outside this review.
